title: Low-degree norm interpolation bound
statement:
Let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube whose Fourier degree is at most $k$. For $1\le p<2$ and $\varepsilon>0$, its uniform $L^2$ norm satisfies
\[\|f\|_2\le (1+\varepsilon)^{(2/p-1)k(1/\varepsilon+1/2)}\|f\|_p.\]
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
Fourier degree of $f$ is at most $k$
